lines.text: Snowed in, and every present is locked in the vault. Eight puzzles. Each answer opens the next lock. A clock grid, a cipher, an ornament scale. Hint cards keep every team moving. Teams of two to five. About one hour. Tap the link, and grab it on Etsy.
